_about: The one pin of Angelo's agent runtime: the patched OpenAI Codex build the app bundles (agent_runtime.py; doc/angelo/gpt_launch.rst, 'Agent runtime and prompt caching'). The app refuses a runtime that reports another version or lacks a listed feature; build_files/cmake/angelo_agent_runtime.cmake installs exactly the listed files, and a release build (ANGELO_REQUIRE_AGENT_RUNTIME) also its release_marker, which makes the app refuse a path in ANGELO_AGENT_RUNTIME; the release checks and the signer read the same lists. On Windows, upstream_signed names OpenAI's unchanged release executables, which ship with OpenAI's own Authenticode signature (upstream_signer): the signer keeps it and refuses to sign over it, and signs the rest (the fork-built codex.exe, codex-code-mode-host.exe and codex-windows-sandbox-setup.exe); macOS re-signs every file. Change a value here, nowhere else.
name: OpenAI Codex

fork._public_commit: public_commit and public_tag: the published branch's head (the same tree as commit, the one the bundled codex was built from) and its tag, added once the maintainer publishes the branch.

_request_fields: Fields the build adds to the parameters of a server request Angelo answers; the release checks find each in the build's app-server schema. Listing DynamicToolCallParams.modelStep (the model request that wrote a dynamic call, the turn's latest, the exec cell) lets the recovery hold judge a yielded exec cell's later edit by the step that wrote it, and end a step at the next request's calls when a provider reports no usage (model_steps.record_call_step); a runtime without it keeps the step a call is checked in.
_config_keys: Launch settings the build adds that Angelo sets only on such a build. Listing runtime_launch.FORWARD_IMAGES_KEY (code mode forwards the pictures of the listed dynamic tools itself) makes Angelo list every tool whose results can carry pictures and tell the model image() is optional (image_proof.py). Listing serial_dynamic_tools (runtime_launch.SERIAL_TOOLS_KEY) checks that the build reads the setting that keeps Angelo's tools one call at a time (agent_execution.rst, "Concurrent calls"); Angelo passes it to every Codex, and one without it ignores it.
_notifications: App-server notifications the build adds that Angelo relies on; the release check finds each in the build's app-server schema. Listing turn/modelInputImages (the pictures each model request carried, by SHA-256) turns on content-proven picture delivery (image_proof.py); a build without it keeps Codex tool pictures unconfirmed. Listing turn/modelRequestStarted (the turn sends its next model request, numbered as item/tool/call's modelStep numbers them) lets the recovery hold end a step at that announcement rather than at usage reports (model_steps.record_request_started).

trust_roots._about: The root-store crates the bundled runtime was built with (the fork's Cargo.lock at commit). scripts/angelo/trust_store.py refuses a release whose webpki-roots is older than its floor or than the newest on crates.io.
